verdict.rationale: Together AI has a dedicated rate-limits page explaining that serverless limits are dynamic per organization and per model, adjusting to live model capacity and recent successful usage. Batch jobs get a separate rate-limit pool and dedicated endpoints have no hard rate limits. Because the limits are dynamic rather than fixed, a developer cannot read concrete thresholds or a tier-by-tier scaling table ahead of production. missing for 10: published numeric limits per tier, documented usage-tier progression, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits and how they scale across usage tiers before I hit them in production

citations.quote: Together uses dynamic rate limits instead of fixed thresholds. Each organization has a dynamic rate per model that adjusts based on: The model's live capacity. Your recent successful usage on that model.
You get up to 50% off serverless rates and a separate rate limit pool
